description.value: Saravanaa Bhavan is a globally established South Indian vegetarian restaurant chain founded in 1981, now operating across 25 countries with over 80 outlets worldwide. The Delta, BC location offers dine-in, takeout, buffet, and catering services specializing in South Indian classics such as dosas, idly, vadas, and rice dishes. The entirely vegetarian menu makes it a standout option for plant-based touring cyclists passing through the Surrey/Delta area.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Canadian branch of the Saravanaa Bhavan South Indian vegetarian chain, with a Delta, BC location at 8701 - 120th Street, Delta, BC, V4C 6R4 and phone 778 578 7575. OSM tags (takeaway=yes, diet:vegetarian=yes) are corroborated by the website's explicit 'Takeout' navigation link and repeated descriptions of the restaurant as an 'authentic Indian vegetarian' chain. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Richmond' but the website's contact page clearly places this branch at 8701 - 120th Street, Delta, BC — Delta and Richmond are neighboring municipalities and this may be a misclassification in OSM.
OSM record contains no address, phone, or email fields; all contact details were sourced from the website and cannot be cross-checked against OSM values.
URL discovery confidence is 'medium' — the saravanabhavan.ca domain covers all Canadian branches, so the Delta BC page content is the relevant evidence for this listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational restaurant with a confirmed Delta, BC location and active website. Fully vegetarian menu is a notable asset for touring cyclists.
